question: what fields does OrderShipmentType have
answer: 53 fields, incl. number, status, statusDisplayValue, items, packages, trackingNumber/Url, fulfillmentCenterId/Name, weight/height/width/length, deliveryDate, comment, isApproved/isCancelled. The storefront's own order query selects only 7 of them: shipmentMethodCode, shipmentMethodOption, shippingMethod, price, discountAmount, deliveryAddress, pickupLocation.
note: Verified against the live /graphql response body for /account/orders/{id}: every field name the storefront returned is in the delivered table, and nothing it returned is absent from it.

question: what fields does OrderShipmentItemType have
answer: 7 fields: barCode, id, lineItem (-> OrderLineItemType), lineItemId, outerId, quantity, status. It is a THIRD shape, thin: it holds its own quantity and status and a reference to the order line item, and carries NO price and no product link of its own -- those are reached through lineItem.
note: Corroborated in Admin: the Shipment line-items grid has exactly the columns Item / Status / Qty / Price, and Price can only come through lineItem since the type has no price field. The grid was EMPTY -- a checkout-created shipment carries no items at all.
